text: dsh-workflow-lite 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 网页与桌面客户端的可视化软工作流插件。它在 DSH 中注册 workflow_lite 工具，并提供工作流画布：用户或模型可以创建和编辑图、配置步骤与资源，再把图编译为任务计划，由当前会话中的模型自行安排执行。插件还支持工作流实例与运行状态记录、进度回传、资源及记忆管理，以及工作流和版本的打包导入导出。它不带执行引擎；无需额外 API 密钥或外部服务，数据保存在本机配置目录。

dsh-workflow-lite adds a canvas for designing workflow graphs and compiling plans for the current DSH model to carry out. It tracks run state, manages resources and memory, and imports or exports workflow packs. No execution engine, extra key, or external service is needed.
想用画布把复杂任务拆成可复用的工作流步骤。
让模型根据预先设计的流程计划逐步完成任务。
我想编辑流程节点、连线和步骤提示词。
怎么让工作流把运行进度显示在画布上？
需要把步骤的输入、输出文件和资源关联起来。
我想在多次运行之间保存工作流状态和经验。
能不能给工作流做版本记录并回退旧版？
如何把工作流连同资源或技能打包导出再导入？
I want to design a reusable task workflow on a visual canvas.
Can a model turn my workflow graph into a plan it can follow?
I need to track workflow progress and state in the canvas.
How can I package and move a workflow with its resources?
dsh-workflow-lite 的功能「canvas」：在画布中创建和编辑工作流图，包括步骤、输入、资源及连接关系，并编译预览计划。
dsh-workflow-lite 的功能「soft-execution」：把图编译成分派计划，由当前会话模型自行决定执行步骤；插件不运行节点或提供调度引擎。
dsh-workflow-lite 的功能「run-state」：为工作流建立运行实例，模型通过 state 动作记录进度，画布展示和编辑状态。
dsh-workflow-lite 的功能「pack」：将工作流与选定版本及可选资源、Skills 打包，并支持导入前检查和导入。

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Introduction：[DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的软工作流插件，基于提示词编排：在画布上设计流程，编译成计划提示词，由模型按计划执行。连线可带**任意条件**，支持顺序、并行、汇合、条件分支、循环、回退等流程结构，无需额外的执行引擎。

> **实验阶段**：功能和数据格式仍在调整，后续任何版本都可能包含不兼容的改动。

**使用文档**：<https://xiaoso456.github.io/dsh-workflow-lite/>——安装、上手、画布展示和各项设置，带截图。

[](./CHANGELOG.md)
@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · 安装：适配 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0 与 0.2.1，包括它们的各个预览版（如 0.2.1-rc.2）。

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · 网页版：需要 Node.js 22 及以上。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite
dsh web
```

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · 桌面端：1. 在侧边栏打开「**插件**」，点击「**添加插件**」→「**安装第三方插件**」。
2. 填入 `@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite`，点击「**安装**」。
3. 重启 DeepSeek Harness。

安装完成后，会话页顶部会出现「**工作流**」标签页。
@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · 跟踪进度：在「工作流设置」中开启「**记录运行状态**」，此后每次执行都会生成一条记录，画布随进度更新。执行记录、工作流与版本统一在画布左上角的「**工作流中心**」中管理。

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · 功能：| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 画布编辑 | 拖拽步骤与连线，支持「通过 / 不通过」分支和循环，一键整理布局 |
| 资源 | 为步骤指定要读写的文件、文件夹、网址或 Skill |
| 执行前提问 | 执行前向用户收集必要信息，答案随计划交给模型 |
| 模型协作编辑 | 模型可以直接创建、修改工作流，画布实时同步 |
| 运行状态 | 执行进度实时显示在画布上；可查看每一步的摘要、调整状态并通知模型 |
| 画布展示（实验性） | 看板、图片、文档、日志、表格和文件夹直接显示在画布上，执行时自动更新；循环每一轮的产出可以回看、对比 |
| 文件预览 | 实例里的资源点开就能看：Markdown、HTML 页面（可做成每轮更新的看板，随时查看循环产出）、图片；文件夹分左右两栏浏览 |
| 版本管理 | 保存版本、添加说明、对比差异、随时切换 |
| 导入导出 | 把工作流和选中的版本打成一个 `.wflite.zip`，可以连同用到的文件与 Skill 一起打包；导入前列出每样东西放到哪 |
| 导出成 Skill | 把一个版本编译成 skill（SKILL.md + 每步的任务描述 + 打包的文件与 Skill），不装插件也能用；下载 zip，或直接装到本机的 `~/.agents/skills` |
| 记忆（实验性） | 工作流把跑通的做法和踩过的坑记成 skill，下次执行照着走；可以在「记忆」页管理、存版本，随工作流包导出 |
| 工作流中心 | 集中管理各会话的执行记录、全部工作流与版本，以及插件设置 |
| 界面 | 浅色、深色各四套配色主题，跟随 DSH 自动切换；中文 / English |

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · 路径变量：资源里的路径和产出根目录可以写下面两个变量，执行时换成实际的位置：

| 变量 | 写在哪 | 换成什么 |
|---|---|---|
| `{workflow}` | 资源里的文件、文件夹路径，如 `{workflow}/refs/notes.md` | 这个工作流自己的目录（默认 `~/.dsh/workflow-lite/assets/<工作流名>/`）。在哪个工作区执行都读写同一份，工作流改名、导出时一起带走 |
| `{instance}` | 「工作流设置」里的「产出根目录」，如默认值 `.workflow-lite/runs/{instance}/out` | 这次执行的实例 id，每次执行的产出各放一处 |

旧版本写的 `{assets}/…` 照样能用，打开工作流时会自动改成 `{workflow}/…`。
@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · 实验性功能：下面的功能还在试验，行为和数据格式后续可能调整；除了工作流记忆，还有上面功能表里的「画布展示」。

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · 工作流记忆：让工作流把跑通的做法记下来，下次执行照着走，目的是加快复杂工作流的执行。

- **使用**：给步骤开一份，或从步骤库「基础」里把「记忆」拖到画布上，作为整个工作流共用的一份；加的时候选已有的，或新建。
- **内容**：一条记忆是一个 skill 文件夹，开头的「快速路径」是下次最省事的走法。各步骤把经验写在回复里，工作流结束时由模型整理进去。
- **管理**：在工作流中心的「记忆」页查看、存版本；导出时可选带不带。
- **限制**：多个实例同时改同一条记忆不加锁，后写的覆盖先写的；重新导出并覆盖安装 Skill，会覆盖已装 skill 里攒下的记忆。

记忆只是一个快捷配置。需要更复杂的玩法时，建议自己用「资源」加提示词实现。

**效果还在验证，欢迎反馈。** 早期在同一个工作流上重复执行的试验里没有看到稳定的提速，后来加入了「快速路径」，是否有用需要更多真实的工作流来检验。

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · 工作原理：1. **设计**：在画布上编排步骤，为每一步写好交给执行者的提示词，用分支和循环描述流程。
2. **编译**：插件把工作流整理成一份计划提示词，写明执行顺序、循环条件、每一步的输入与产出。
3. **执行**：模型按计划自行安排执行方式（直接完成、派发子代理或组建团队），并把进度同步回画布。

插件本身不包含执行引擎，也无需额外服务；调度与判断交由当前会话中的模型完成。

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Introduction：A soft-workflow plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness), built on prompt orchestration: design a flow on a canvas, compile it into a plan prompt, and let the model carry it out. Edges can carry **any condition**, and flows can be sequential, parallel, joined, conditionally branched, looped or rolled back, with no extra execution engine required.

> **Experimental**: features and data formats are still changing, and any release may include breaking changes.

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Introduction：**Documentation**: <https://xiaoso456.github.io/dsh-workflow-lite/> (installation, first steps, canvas display and settings, with screenshots).

[](./CHANGELOG.md)
@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Install：Works with DeepSeek Harness 0.2.0 and 0.2.1, including their preview builds (such as 0.2.1-rc.2).

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Web：Requires Node.js 22 or later.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite
dsh web
```

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Desktop：1. Open **Plugins** in the sidebar, then click **Add plugin** → **Install a third-party plugin**.
2. Enter `@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite` and click **Install**.
3. Restart DeepSeek Harness.

Once installed, a **Workflow** tab appears at the top of the session page.

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Follow progress：Turn on **Record run state** in **Workflow settings**. Every run then leaves a record and the canvas updates as the model works. Run records, workflows and versions are managed in the **Workflow hub**, opened from the top-left corner of the canvas.

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Features：| Feature | Description |
|---|---|
| Canvas editing | Drag steps and connect them, with pass / fail branches and loops; tidy the layout in one click |
| Resources | Attach files, folders, URLs or Skills that a step reads or writes |
| Pre-run questions | Collect the information a run needs from the user; answers are passed to the model with the plan |
| Model co-editing | The model can create and edit workflows directly, and the canvas updates live |
| Run state | Progress appears on the canvas as it happens; read each step's summary, adjust its state, and the model is notified |
| Canvas display (beta) | Dashboards, images, documents, logs, tables and folders show right on the canvas and update during a run; review and compare each round of a loop |
| File preview | Open a run's resources in place: Markdown, HTML pages (make one a dashboard updated every round to follow a loop's output), images; browse folders in a two-pane view |
| Versions | Save versions with notes, compare differences, switch back at any time |
| Import / export | Pack a workflow and the versions you pick into one `.wflite.zip`, optionally with the files and Skills
@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Path variables：Resource paths and the output root accept two variables, replaced with real locations at run time:

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Path variables：| Variable | Where | Becomes |
|---|---|---|
| `{workflow}` | File and folder paths in resources, e.g. `{workflow}/refs/notes.md` | The workflow's own folder (by default `~/.dsh/workflow-lite/assets/<workflow name>/`). Every workspace reads and writes the same copy, and it moves with the workflow when you rename or export it |
| `{instance}` | **Output root** in **Workflow settings**, e.g. the default `.workflow-lite/runs/{instance}/out` | The id of this run's instance, so each run keeps its outputs apart |
@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Path variables：Paths written as `{assets}/…` by earlier versions still work and become `{workflow}/…` when the workflow is opened.

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Experimental features：These features are still being tried out, and their behavior and data formats may change. Besides workflow memory, there is **Canvas display** in the feature table above.
@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Workflow memory：Lets a workflow keep what worked and follow it on the next run, with the aim of speeding up complex workflows.

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Workflow memory：- **Use it**: turn it on for a step, or drag **Memory** from **Basics** in the step library onto the canvas as one shared by the whole workflow; pick an existing entry or create a new one when you add it.
- **Content**: an entry is a skill folder, and the "Quick path" at its top is the cheapest way to do the task next time. Each step reports what it learned in its reply, and when the workflow ends the model folds that in.
- **Manage it**: view and version entries on the **Memory** page in the workflow hub; choose whether to include them when you export.
- **Limits**: instances running at the same time that change the same memory are not locked, so the later write overwrites the earlier one; re-exporting a Skill over an installed copy overwrites the memory it has built up.

@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · Workflow memory：Memory is only a configuration shortcut. For anything more elaborate, build it yourself with a resource plus prompts.

**We are still checking whether it helps, and we'd like your feedback.** In early trials that repeated one workflow, we saw no steady speedup; the "Quick path" was added afterwards, and whether it helps needs more real workflows to tell.
@xiaoso/dsh-workflow-lite README · How it works：The plugin ships no execution engine and needs no extra service; scheduling and judgement stay with the model in your current session.
